addr: 914, 28th Main Rd, Putlanpalya, Jayanagara 9th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: It is one of the best places to buy groceries at wholesale price. Staff are very co-operative, and administrators are very kind.

Well stocked and reasonable price commensurate with quality. Has groceries, cosmetics, dry fruits Etc. Personalised service by staff. Only street side parking. Accepts cash, card. No waiting. Located in two floors. Most of the items sell below MRP.
You will get all good quality and fair prices for all home needs like groceries and daily use toiletries, food items!👌 …
